sources.title: Università per Stranieri di Perugia, CELI 5 (C2): competenze richieste

units.title: Nuanced grammatical choices
units.description: Choose forms by evidence, viewpoint and degree of certainty.

lessons.title: Evidence and speaker stance
lessons.outcome: I can distinguish an asserted fact from a speaker’s inference.
lessons.takeaway: So che asserts; è possibile che presents possibility.

objectives.label: Use an indicative assertion or a subjunctive evaluation according to the matrix clause.
objectives.explanation: C2 control includes choosing a mood for stance, not applying one mechanical rule to every che-clause.

teach.title: Assert evidence
teach.body: So che presents information as known.

examples.it: So che il treno è partito.
examples.en: I know the train has left.

teach.title: Evaluate uncertainty
teach.body: È possibile che places the event in the realm of possibility.

examples.it: È possibile che il treno sia partito.
examples.en: It is possible that the train has left.

teach.tip: Keep the time relationship while changing stance.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Il tabellone lo conferma: so che il treno ___ .
questions.translation: The board confirms it: I know the train has left.
questions.explanation: So che plus confirmed information takes an indicative assertion.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il tabellone lo conferma: so che il treno è partito.

questions.prompt: Begin with È possibile che.
questions.context: Il treno è partito. Presentalo come una possibilità, non un fatto verificato.
questions.translation: The train has left; present this as possible, not verified.
questions.answer: È possibile che il treno sia partito.
questions.explanation: È possibile che calls for the subjunctive while sia partito preserves prior completion.
questions.speak: È possibile che il treno sia partito.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Non ho conferma: è possibile che il treno ___ .
questions.translation: I have no confirmation: the train may have left.
questions.explanation: The speaker evaluates an earlier event as possible, so sia partito.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Non ho conferma: è possibile che il treno sia partito.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Il rapporto conferma che i dati sono corretti.
questions.translation: The report confirms that the data are correct.
questions.answer: Il rapporto conferma che i dati sono corretti.
questions.explanation: Conferma presents the content as verified and takes indicative sono.
questions.speak: Il rapporto conferma che i dati sono corretti.

lessons.title: Event boundary and viewpoint
lessons.outcome: I can choose a past form to foreground an event or its background.
lessons.takeaway: Imperfetto frames; a perfective past form closes an event.

objectives.label: Use passato prossimo for a bounded event and imperfetto for the ongoing background in this context.
objectives.explanation: The same real-world episode can be packaged differently according to the narrative viewpoint.

teach.title: Background state
teach.body: Imperfetto places the reader inside an ongoing scene.

examples.it: Pioveva quando uscimmo.
examples.en: It was raining when we went out.

teach.title: Bounded event
teach.body: Passato prossimo presents a completed occurrence.

examples.it: Ha piovuto tutta la notte.
examples.en: It rained all night.

teach.tip: A duration can still be presented as bounded.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Quando sono uscito, ___ già.
questions.translation: When I went out, it was already raining.
questions.explanation: Pioveva supplies the ongoing background at my departure.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Quando sono uscito, pioveva già.

questions.prompt: Rewrite with the verb piovere in a perfective past.
questions.context: Ieri la pioggia è durata tutta la notte.
questions.translation: Yesterday the rain lasted the whole night as a complete episode.
questions.answer: Ieri ha piovuto tutta la notte.
accepted: Ieri è piovuto per tutta la notte.
questions.explanation: Ha piovuto presents the full night’s rain as a bounded episode.
questions.speak: Ieri ha piovuto tutta la notte.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Alle otto il pubblico ___ ancora, poi è arrivato il relatore.
questions.translation: At eight the audience was still waiting; then the speaker arrived.
questions.explanation: Aspettava frames the ongoing state when the later event occurred.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Alle otto il pubblico aspettava ancora, poi è arrivato il relatore.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Mentre Marta leggeva, è suonato il telefono.
questions.translation: While Marta was reading, the phone rang.
questions.answer: Mentre Marta leggeva, è suonato il telefono.
questions.explanation: Leggeva is background; è suonato is the bounded interruption.
questions.speak: Mentre Marta leggeva, è suonato il telefono.

lessons.title: Degrees of inference
lessons.outcome: I can express strong or tentative inference about an earlier action.
lessons.takeaway: Deve aver = strong inference; potrebbe aver = tentative possibility.

objectives.label: Distinguish deve aver + participle from potrebbe aver + participle.
objectives.explanation: Deve aver marks a strong inference in context; potrebbe aver leaves more room for alternatives.

teach.title: Strong inference
teach.body: Deve aver expresses a conclusion supported by strong evidence.

examples.it: La porta è aperta: deve essere uscito.
examples.en: The door is open: he must have gone out.

teach.title: Tentative possibility
teach.body: Potrebbe aver presents a possible explanation.

examples.it: Potrebbe aver perso le chiavi.
examples.en: He may have lost the keys.

teach.tip: Neither expression is a direct observation.

questions.prompt: Choose the stronger inference supported by the evidence.
questions.context: La cucina è piena di fumo: qualcuno ___ bruciato la cena.
questions.translation: The kitchen is full of smoke: someone must have burned dinner.
questions.explanation: The conspicuous smoke supports a strong inference, expressed by deve aver.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: La cucina è piena di fumo: qualcuno deve aver bruciato la cena.

questions.prompt: Rewrite with potrebbe aver.
questions.context: Forse Giulia ha perso le chiavi; non ne siamo sicuri.
questions.translation: Perhaps Giulia lost the keys; we are not sure.
questions.answer: Giulia potrebbe aver perso le chiavi.
accepted: Giulia potrebbe avere perso le chiavi.
questions.explanation: Potrebbe aver keeps the past event tentative.
questions.speak: Giulia potrebbe aver perso le chiavi.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Non sappiamo perché manchi il libro: Luca ___ preso per errore.
questions.translation: We do not know why the book is missing: Luca might have taken it by mistake.
questions.explanation: Potrebbe averlo expresses one unverified explanation.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Non sappiamo perché manchi il libro: Luca potrebbe averlo preso per errore.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Deve aver dimenticato l’indirizzo: continua a chiamare.
questions.translation: He must have forgotten the address: he keeps calling.
questions.answer: Deve aver dimenticato l’indirizzo: continua a chiamare.
questions.explanation: Deve aver presents a strong inference about an earlier lapse.
questions.speak: Deve aver dimenticato l’indirizzo: continua a chiamare.

units.title: Advanced hypotheticals
units.description: Track unreal pasts, present results and implicit conditions.

lessons.title: Unreal past conditions
lessons.outcome: I can state an unreal past condition and its unreal result.
lessons.takeaway: Se avessi fatto ... avrei fatto ... for an unreal past.

objectives.label: Use se + trapassato congiuntivo with a past conditional result.
objectives.explanation: The result is counterfactual because the stated past condition did not happen.

teach.title: Past condition
teach.body: Se avessi saputo describes an unreal prior condition.

examples.it: Se avessi saputo, sarei venuto.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have come.

teach.title: Past result
teach.body: The apodosis takes a past conditional for the unreal outcome.

examples.it: Se fossimo partiti prima, avremmo preso il treno.
examples.en: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

teach.tip: Do not use se avrei in a standard conditional protasis.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Se lo ___ ieri, ti avrei chiamato.
questions.translation: If I had known it yesterday, I would have called you.
questions.explanation: Se introduces the unreal condition with avessi saputo.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Se lo avessi saputo ieri, ti avrei chiamato.

questions.prompt: Rewrite as an unreal past condition.
questions.context: Non siamo partiti prima, quindi abbiamo perso il treno.
questions.translation: We did not leave earlier, so we missed the train.
questions.answer: Se fossimo partiti prima, avremmo preso il treno.
accepted: Se fossimo partiti prima, non avremmo perso il treno.
questions.explanation: The unreal earlier departure and result require trapassato congiuntivo plus past conditional.
questions.speak: Se fossimo partiti prima, avremmo preso il treno.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Se Marta fosse arrivata in tempo, ___ il discorso.
questions.translation: If Marta had arrived on time, she would have heard the speech.
questions.explanation: The unreal result uses avrebbe sentito.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Se Marta fosse arrivata in tempo, avrebbe sentito il discorso.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Se avessimo prenotato, avremmo trovato posto.
questions.translation: If we had booked, we would have found a place.
questions.answer: Se avessimo prenotato, avremmo trovato posto.
questions.explanation: The two compound forms mark unreal condition and result.
questions.speak: Se avessimo prenotato, avremmo trovato posto.

lessons.title: Past cause, present result
lessons.outcome: I can connect an unreal past condition to a present state.
lessons.takeaway: Past unreal cause + present conditional result: se avessi..., ora sarei....

objectives.label: Use a past subjunctive condition with a present conditional result when the result is now.
objectives.explanation: A mixed conditional locates the unreal cause in the past and its consequence in the present.

teach.title: Past cause
teach.body: The condition did not happen earlier.

examples.it: Se avessi dormito, ora starei meglio.
examples.en: If I had slept, I would feel better now.

teach.title: Present consequence
teach.body: The result is a present state, so use the present conditional.

examples.it: Se avessimo studiato, oggi sapremmo rispondere.
examples.en: If we had studied, we would know how to answer today.

teach.tip: Now or oggi anchors the present result.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Se ieri avessi dormito, ora ___ meno stanco.
questions.translation: If I had slept yesterday, I would be less tired now.
questions.explanation: Ora makes the result present, so sarei.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Se ieri avessi dormito, ora sarei meno stanco.

questions.prompt: Rewrite as a mixed conditional.
questions.context: Non ho studiato prima; oggi non so rispondere.
questions.translation: I did not study earlier; today I cannot answer.
questions.answer: Se avessi studiato, oggi saprei rispondere.
accepted: Se avessi studiato, saprei rispondere oggi.
questions.explanation: Avessi studiato is the unreal past cause; saprei is its present result.
questions.speak: Se avessi studiato, oggi saprei rispondere.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Se avessimo preso il treno delle sette, adesso ___ a Roma.
questions.translation: If we had taken the seven o’clock train, we would be in Rome now.
questions.explanation: Adesso calls for the present conditional state saremmo.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Se avessimo preso il treno delle sette, adesso saremmo a Roma.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Se avessi ascoltato il consiglio, oggi avrei più tempo.
questions.translation: If I had taken the advice, I would have more time today.
questions.answer: Se avessi ascoltato il consiglio, oggi avrei più tempo.
questions.explanation: The past condition has a present consequence.
questions.speak: Se avessi ascoltato il consiglio, oggi avrei più tempo.

lessons.title: Conditions without se
lessons.outcome: I can recognize an implied condition in a compact phrase.
lessons.takeaway: Con or senza + noun can carry an implied if-clause.

objectives.label: Read senza + noun or con + noun as an implicit hypothetical when paired with a conditional.
objectives.explanation: An implicit phrase can stand for a fuller if-clause; the conditional shows its hypothetical status.

teach.title: With a condition
teach.body: Con più tempo can mean if I had more time.

examples.it: Con più tempo, leggerei di più.
examples.en: With more time, I would read more.

teach.title: Without a condition
teach.body: Senza il tuo aiuto can mean if I did not have your help.

examples.it: Senza il tuo aiuto, non riuscirei.
examples.en: Without your help, I would not manage.

teach.tip: Make the implied condition explicit when clarity matters.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: ___ più tempo, leggerei ogni giorno.
questions.translation: If I had more time, I would read every day.
questions.explanation: Con più tempo is the compact implicit condition here.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Con più tempo, leggerei ogni giorno.

questions.prompt: Condense the if-clause with senza.
questions.context: Se non avessi il tuo aiuto, non riuscirei.
questions.translation: If I did not have your help, I would not manage.
questions.answer: Senza il tuo aiuto, non riuscirei.
questions.explanation: Senza il tuo aiuto replaces the full negative condition.
questions.speak: Senza il tuo aiuto, non riuscirei.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: ___ una mappa, troveremmo subito la strada.
questions.translation: If we had a map, we would find the way immediately.
questions.explanation: Con una mappa supplies the implied condition.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Con una mappa, troveremmo subito la strada.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Senza un accordo, il progetto si fermerebbe.
questions.translation: Without an agreement, the project would stop.
questions.answer: Senza un accordo, il progetto si fermerebbe.
questions.explanation: Senza un accordo gives the unstated if-condition.
questions.speak: Senza un accordo, il progetto si fermerebbe.

units.title: Scope and unambiguous reference
units.description: Edit sentences so readers know exactly who and how many.

lessons.title: Resolve competing antecedents
lessons.outcome: I can remove a pronoun ambiguity in a short text.
lessons.takeaway: A repeated name can be more precise than an ambiguous pronoun.

objectives.label: Repeat a name or role when two referents could fit a pronoun.
objectives.explanation: In precise prose, explicit reference often serves better than a formally grammatical but unclear pronoun.

teach.title: Ambiguous reference
teach.body: Lui can refer to either man if both are in view.

examples.it: Paolo ha scritto a Marco. Lui era preoccupato.
examples.en: Paolo wrote to Marco. He was worried.

teach.title: Explicit repair
teach.body: Name the intended person in the second clause.

examples.it: Paolo ha scritto a Marco. Marco era preoccupato.
examples.en: Paolo wrote to Marco. Marco was worried.

teach.tip: Do not make the reader infer an antecedent without evidence.

questions.prompt: Choose the clearest subject: Marco is the worried person.
questions.context: Paolo ha scritto a Marco. ___ era preoccupato.
questions.translation: Paolo wrote to Marco. Marco was worried.
questions.explanation: Marco uniquely identifies the intended person here.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Paolo ha scritto a Marco. Marco era preoccupato.

questions.prompt: Rewrite the second sentence to make the reference explicit.
questions.context: Anna ha chiamato Marta. Lei era in ritardo. Intendi Marta.
questions.translation: Anna called Marta. Marta was late.
questions.answer: Anna ha chiamato Marta. Marta era in ritardo.
accepted: Anna ha chiamato Marta; Marta era in ritardo.
questions.explanation: Repeating Marta eliminates the two possible readings of lei.
questions.speak: Anna ha chiamato Marta. Marta era in ritardo.

questions.prompt: Choose the clearest subject: the patient returns tomorrow.
questions.context: Il medico ha parlato al paziente. ___ tornerà domani.
questions.translation: The doctor spoke to the patient. The patient will return tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Il paziente fixes the intended referent.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il medico ha parlato al paziente. Il paziente tornerà domani.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Giulia ha salutato Laura. Laura è partita subito.
questions.translation: Giulia greeted Laura. Laura left immediately.
questions.answer: Giulia ha salutato Laura. Laura è partita subito.
questions.explanation: Repeating Laura avoids an unclear lei.
questions.speak: Giulia ha salutato Laura. Laura è partita subito.

lessons.title: Possession in relative clauses
lessons.outcome: I can express whose item is involved without a vague pronoun.
lessons.takeaway: Il cui costo; la cui firma: the article matches the possessed noun.

objectives.label: Use il cui / la cui + possessed noun with agreement to the possessed noun.
objectives.explanation: Cui itself is invariable; the article agrees with the noun that follows, not with the antecedent.

teach.title: Masculine possessed noun
teach.body: Il cui costo agrees with costo.

examples.it: Il progetto il cui costo è alto sarà rivisto.
examples.en: The project whose cost is high will be reviewed.

teach.title: Feminine possessed noun
teach.body: La cui firma agrees with firma.

examples.it: La donna la cui firma manca è assente.
examples.en: The woman whose signature is missing is absent.

teach.tip: Possession is shown by cui, while the article follows the possessed noun.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Il progetto ___ costo è alto sarà rivisto.
questions.translation: The project whose cost is high will be reviewed.
questions.explanation: Costo is masculine singular, so il cui.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il progetto il cui costo è alto sarà rivisto.

questions.prompt: Combine with la cui firma.
questions.context: La donna è assente. La firma della donna manca.
questions.translation: The woman whose signature is missing is absent.
questions.answer: La donna la cui firma manca è assente.
questions.explanation: La cui agrees with the feminine noun firma.
questions.speak: La donna la cui firma manca è assente.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: L’autrice ___ romanzi leggo vive a Torino.
questions.translation: The author whose novels I read lives in Turin.
questions.explanation: Romanzi is masculine plural, so i cui.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: L’autrice i cui romanzi leggo vive a Torino.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Ho incontrato il musicista le cui canzoni ami.
questions.translation: I met the musician whose songs you love.
questions.answer: Ho incontrato il musicista le cui canzoni ami.
questions.explanation: Le cui agrees with feminine plural canzoni.
questions.speak: Ho incontrato il musicista le cui canzoni ami.

lessons.title: Quantifier scope under negation
lessons.outcome: I can distinguish “not all” from “none.”
lessons.takeaway: Non tutti allows some; nessuno excludes all.

objectives.label: Use non tutti for a partial negative and nessuno for a total negative.
objectives.explanation: The placement of negation changes the logical claim; non tutti leaves open that some did.

teach.title: Partial negative
teach.body: Non tutti means at least one exception.

examples.it: Non tutti gli ospiti sono arrivati.
examples.en: Not all the guests arrived.

teach.title: Total negative
teach.body: Nessuno means zero members.

examples.it: Nessun ospite è arrivato.
examples.en: No guest arrived.

teach.tip: Avoid treating non tutti as equivalent to nessuno.

questions.prompt: Choose the logically accurate full statement.
questions.context: Tre dei cinque ospiti sono arrivati: ___ .
questions.translation: Three of five guests arrived: not all arrived.
questions.answer: Non tutti gli ospiti sono arrivati
options: Non tutti gli ospiti sono arrivati
questions.explanation: Three arrived, so non tutti is true while nessuno is false.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Non tutti gli ospiti sono arrivati.

questions.prompt: Rewrite with non tutti.
questions.context: Alcuni studenti hanno capito, altri no.
questions.translation: Some students understood, others did not.
questions.answer: Non tutti gli studenti hanno capito.
questions.explanation: Non tutti precisely expresses the partial negative.
questions.speak: Non tutti gli studenti hanno capito.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Sono state presentate tre domande, ma ___.
questions.translation: Zero questions received an answer.
questions.explanation: Nessuna expresses zero answered questions, unlike non tutte.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Sono state presentate tre domande, ma nessuna ha ricevuto risposta.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Non tutti i partecipanti erano d’accordo.
questions.translation: Not all participants agreed.
questions.answer: Non tutti i partecipanti erano d’accordo.
questions.explanation: Non tutti signals that at least one participant dissented.
questions.speak: Non tutti i partecipanti erano d’accordo.

units.title: Ellipsis and implication
units.description: Recover what a short expression leaves unsaid.

lessons.title: Parallel ellipsis
lessons.outcome: I can omit a repeated verb without hiding the relationship.
lessons.takeaway: Omit a repeated verb only when the reader can recover it exactly.

objectives.label: In balanced clauses, omit a recoverable repeated verb and keep the two parts parallel.
objectives.explanation: A comma may mark the place of an omitted verb in compact edited prose.

teach.title: Recoverable predicate
teach.body: The second clause inherits the first clause’s verb.

examples.it: Marta legge romanzi; Luca, saggi.
examples.en: Marta reads novels; Luca, essays.

teach.title: Parallel structure
teach.body: The omitted verb must fit the second clause too.

examples.it: Io porto il pane; tu, l’acqua.
examples.en: I will bring the bread; you, the water.

teach.tip: Keep the matching roles in matching positions.

questions.prompt: Complete the compact parallel clause without repeating the verb.
questions.context: Marta legge romanzi; Luca, ___ .
questions.translation: Marta reads novels; Luca reads essays.
questions.explanation: The repeated verb legge is understood, leaving the object saggi.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Marta legge romanzi; Luca, saggi.

questions.prompt: Rewrite with a clear ellipsis after tu.
questions.context: Io porto il pane; tu porti l’acqua.
questions.translation: I bring bread; you bring water.
questions.answer: Io porto il pane; tu, l’acqua.
accepted: Io porto il pane, tu l’acqua.
questions.explanation: The parallel subject and object let the second verb be omitted.
questions.speak: Io porto il pane; tu, l’acqua.

questions.prompt: Complete with ellipsis, omitting the repeated verb.
questions.context: Anna scrive la relazione; Paolo, ___ .
questions.translation: Anna writes the report; Paolo writes the summary.
questions.explanation: The second object completes the balanced clause with scrive understood.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Anna scrive la relazione; Paolo, il riassunto.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Giulia sceglie il tè; Marco, il caffè.
questions.translation: Giulia chooses tea; Marco chooses coffee.
questions.answer: Giulia sceglie il tè; Marco, il caffè.
questions.explanation: The omitted sceglie is recoverable from the first clause.
questions.speak: Giulia sceglie il tè; Marco, il caffè.

lessons.title: Implications of aspect verbs
lessons.outcome: I can infer what smettere and riprendere imply.
lessons.takeaway: Smesso di and ripreso a carry information about an earlier phase.

objectives.label: Recognize the earlier activity implied by smettere and riprendere.
objectives.explanation: Smettere di X implies X occurred before; riprendere a X implies X occurred earlier and was interrupted.

teach.title: Stopping
teach.body: Smettere di presupposes an activity before the stopping point.

examples.it: Marta ha smesso di fumare.
examples.en: Marta stopped smoking.

teach.tip: It does not say when the earlier activity began.

teach.title: Resuming
teach.body: Riprendere a presupposes an earlier phase and interruption.

examples.it: Marta ha ripreso a correre.
examples.en: Marta has started running again.

questions.prompt: Choose the implication supported by the sentence.
questions.context: “Marta ha smesso di fumare.” Che cosa si può dedurre? ___ .
questions.translation: “Marta stopped smoking.” What follows: she smoked before.
questions.explanation: Stopping smoking presupposes earlier smoking.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Prima Marta fumava.

questions.prompt: Condense with riprendere a.
questions.context: Marta correva, poi ha interrotto. Ora corre di nuovo.
questions.translation: Marta used to run, stopped, and now runs again.
questions.explanation: Riprendere a correre packages the earlier activity and return.
questions.speak: Marta ha ripreso a correre.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: “Luca ha ripreso a studiare.” È implicito che ___ .
questions.translation: “Luca resumed studying.” It follows that he studied before.
questions.explanation: Riprendere entails an earlier phase of the activity.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Luca studiava già in precedenza.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Dopo una pausa, Anna ha ripreso a leggere.
questions.translation: After a break, Anna resumed reading.
questions.answer: Dopo una pausa, Anna ha ripreso a leggere.
questions.explanation: Ripreso a signals the return after interruption.
questions.speak: Dopo una pausa, Anna ha ripreso a leggere.

units.title: Literary and historical forms
units.description: Read marked written forms and restate them in current usage.

lessons.title: Narrative past and present relevance
lessons.outcome: I can recognize the narrative function of passato remoto.
lessons.takeaway: Read remoto as a narrative past; choose it when the historical style is specified.

objectives.label: Use passato remoto for a closed historical narrative when the task asks for that style.
objectives.explanation: Passato prossimo also occurs in Italian narratives; this lesson fixes the intended written register explicitly.

teach.title: Historical narration
teach.body: Passato remoto can advance a sequence of completed past events.

examples.it: Nel 1861 il Parlamento proclamò il Regno d’Italia.
examples.en: In 1861 Parliament proclaimed the Kingdom of Italy.

teach.title: Contemporary restatement
teach.body: Passato prossimo often suits a current report about a recent event.

examples.it: Oggi il Parlamento ha approvato la legge.
examples.en: Today Parliament approved the law.

teach.tip: Regional and stylistic variation affects everyday choices.

questions.prompt: Choose the passato remoto form for historical narration.
questions.context: Nel 1861 il Parlamento ___ il Regno d’Italia.
questions.translation: In historical narration: in 1861 Parliament proclaimed the Kingdom of Italy.
questions.explanation: Proclamò is the requested passato remoto for the bounded historical event.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Nel 1861 il Parlamento proclamò il Regno d’Italia.

questions.prompt: Rewrite in passato remoto.
questions.context: Nel 1861 il Parlamento ha proclamato il Regno d’Italia.
questions.translation: In 1861 Parliament proclaimed the Kingdom of Italy; use literary historical narration.
questions.answer: Nel 1861 il Parlamento proclamò il Regno d’Italia.
questions.explanation: Proclamò gives the event in passato remoto as requested.
questions.speak: Nel 1861 il Parlamento proclamò il Regno d’Italia.

questions.prompt: Choose the passato remoto form for historical narration.
questions.context: Il re ___ la lettera e uscì.
questions.translation: In a historical narrative: the king read the letter and went out.
questions.explanation: Lesse is the passato remoto matching the bounded sequence with uscì.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il re lesse la lettera e uscì.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Entrò il messaggero e consegnò la lettera.
questions.translation: The messenger entered and delivered the letter; historical narration.
questions.answer: Entrò il messaggero e consegnò la lettera.
questions.explanation: Entrò and consegnò advance the narrative with passato remoto.
questions.speak: Entrò il messaggero e consegnò la lettera.

lessons.title: Marked order in literary narration
lessons.outcome: I can interpret a literary subject placed after the verb.
lessons.takeaway: In “Entrò il messaggero,” il messaggero is the subject.

objectives.label: Recognize verb–subject order as a way of introducing a new actor in a narrative scene.
objectives.explanation: In this context, the postverbal noun remains the subject, not the object.

teach.title: Actor after verb
teach.body: The subject can follow an intransitive verb in narration.

examples.it: Entrò il messaggero.
examples.en: The messenger entered.

teach.title: Current paraphrase
teach.body: A neutral paraphrase can put the subject first.

examples.it: Il messaggero entrò.
examples.en: The messenger entered.

teach.tip: The order change shifts presentation, not who acted.

questions.prompt: Identify the grammatical subject in the quoted narrative sentence.
questions.context: “Arrivò il sindaco.” Chi arrivò? ___ .
questions.translation: “The mayor arrived.” Who arrived? The mayor.
questions.explanation: Il sindaco is the postverbal subject of arrivò.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Arrivò il sindaco.

questions.prompt: Put the subject first.
questions.context: Entrò il messaggero.
questions.translation: The messenger entered; restate with neutral subject-first order.
questions.explanation: The subject moves before the verb without changing the event.
questions.speak: Il messaggero entrò.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: “Si aprì la porta ed entrò una donna.” Il soggetto di entrò è ___ .
questions.translation: “The door opened and a woman entered.” The subject of entered is a woman.
questions.explanation: Una donna is the noun after entrò and the person entering.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Si aprì la porta ed entrò una donna.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: All’improvviso apparve una luce.
questions.translation: Suddenly a light appeared.
questions.explanation: Una luce is the postverbal subject of apparve.
questions.speak: All’improvviso apparve una luce.

units.title: Variation and register
units.description: Recognize spoken constructions and choose edited alternatives.

lessons.title: Spoken dislocation in context
lessons.outcome: I can identify a spoken topic structure and recast it for a formal text.
lessons.takeaway: Recognize spoken topicalization; edit to a neutral formal order when asked.

objectives.label: Recognize clitic resumption as common in conversation; choose a neutral order for formal editing when needed.
objectives.explanation: Spoken “a me mi” is a marked topicalization; formal prose can say “a me piace” or use a neutral clause.

teach.title: Conversation
teach.body: A left topic with clitic can occur naturally in speech.

examples.it: A me, questa idea mi piace.
examples.en: As for me, I like this idea.

teach.title: Edited alternative
teach.body: A more neutral written form can omit the repeated clitic.

examples.it: A me piace questa idea.
examples.en: I like this idea.

teach.tip: Register depends on situation, not a blanket right/wrong label.

questions.prompt: Choose the neutral wording for a formal report.
questions.translation: For a formal report, choose the neutral version: I like this idea.
options: A me questa idea mi piace
A me mi piace questa idea
questions.explanation: Mi piace questa idea is the unmarked concise written form.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Mi piace questa idea.

questions.prompt: Rewrite in neutral edited prose.
questions.context: A me, questa proposta mi sembra utile.
questions.translation: As for me, this proposal seems useful; rewrite neutrally for a report.
questions.explanation: Removing the fronted topic leaves a clear neutral written clause.
questions.speak: Questa proposta mi sembra utile.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: «Il libro, l’ho già letto»: il tema è ___.
questions.translation: In conversation, “The book, I have already read it” topicalizes the book.
questions.explanation: The fronted object il libro is the topic, resumed by l’.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il libro, l’ho già letto.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Il film mi è piaciuto molto.
questions.translation: I liked the film very much; neutral written wording.
questions.answer: Il film mi è piaciuto molto.
questions.explanation: The neutral clause conveys the evaluation without topicalization.
questions.speak: Il film mi è piaciuto molto.

questions.prompt: Rewrite in neutral edited prose.
questions.context: A me, questo film mi è sembrato lento.
questions.translation: As for me, this film seemed slow; rewrite neutrally for a review.
questions.answer: Questo film mi è sembrato lento.
questions.explanation: Removing the fronted topic leaves a neutral written clause.
questions.speak: Questo film mi è sembrato lento.

lessons.title: Match request to audience
lessons.outcome: I can rewrite a direct request for a formal recipient while preserving the request.
lessons.takeaway: A formal request can use Potrebbe + infinitive.

objectives.label: Use a courteous conditional and a clear request complement in formal correspondence.
objectives.explanation: Formal tone comes from grammar and framing as well as word choice.

teach.title: Direct to a friend
teach.body: A direct imperative fits familiar speech.

examples.it: Mandami il documento.
examples.en: Send me the document.

teach.title: Formal recipient
teach.body: Potrebbe + infinitive makes the same request more courteous.

examples.it: Potrebbe inviarmi il documento?
examples.en: Could you send me the document?

teach.tip: Do not change what is being requested.

questions.prompt: Choose the courteous form specified by the situation.
questions.context: A un ufficio, in un’e-mail formale: “___ il documento?”
questions.translation: In a formal email to an office: “Could you send me the document?”
questions.explanation: Potrebbe inviarmi expresses the request courteously and directly.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Potrebbe inviarmi il documento?

questions.prompt: Rewrite as a formal question with Potrebbe.
questions.context: Mandami il modulo.
questions.translation: Send me the form; address a public office politely.
questions.explanation: Potrebbe inviarmi changes the directive to a courteous question.
questions.speak: Potrebbe inviarmi il modulo?

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: A un amico con cui parli abitualmente in modo informale: “___ il link?”
questions.translation: To a friend you normally address informally: “Can you send me the link?”
questions.explanation: Mi mandi is a natural familiar request in this context.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Mi mandi il link?

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Potrebbe indicarmi l’orario di apertura?
questions.translation: Could you tell me the opening time?
questions.explanation: Potrebbe makes the request courteous for a formal recipient.
questions.speak: Potrebbe indicarmi l’orario di apertura?

units.title: Edit a complex text
units.description: Correct logical links, compress repetition and keep parallel structures.

lessons.title: Repair a false logical link
lessons.outcome: I can replace a connector that misstates the relation between claims.
lessons.takeaway: Edit a connector to express the real cause or contrast.

objectives.label: Choose a connector from the actual logic, not from surface punctuation.
objectives.explanation: A misleading connective can make a grammatical text incoherent.

teach.title: Cause and result
teach.body: Perciò signals a result from the prior claim.

examples.it: La strada è chiusa; perciò deviamo.
examples.en: The road is closed; therefore we detour.

teach.title: Unexpected contrast
teach.body: Eppure signals an outcome contrary to expectation.

examples.it: La strada è lunga; eppure arriviamo presto.
examples.en: The road is long; yet we arrive early.

teach.tip: The second claim determines which relation is defensible.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: La strada è chiusa; ___ dobbiamo deviare.
questions.translation: The road is closed; therefore we must detour.
questions.explanation: The detour follows from the closure, so perciò.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: La strada è chiusa; perciò dobbiamo deviare.

questions.prompt: Replace the misleading connector.
questions.context: Il treno è in ritardo; tuttavia arriveremo tardi.
questions.translation: The train is delayed; therefore we will arrive late.
questions.answer: Il treno è in ritardo; perciò arriveremo tardi.
accepted: Il treno è in ritardo; quindi arriveremo tardi.
questions.explanation: Perciò repairs the mistaken contrast and shows consequence.
questions.speak: Il treno è in ritardo; perciò arriveremo tardi.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Il percorso è lungo; ___ siamo arrivati in anticipo.
questions.translation: The route is long; yet we arrived early.
questions.explanation: Early arrival contrasts with the expected effect of a long route.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il percorso è lungo; eppure siamo arrivati in anticipo.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Il prezzo è alto; tuttavia il prodotto si vende bene.
questions.translation: The price is high; nevertheless the product sells well.
questions.answer: Il prezzo è alto; tuttavia il prodotto si vende bene.
questions.explanation: Tuttavia links unexpectedly strong sales to a high price.
questions.speak: Il prezzo è alto; tuttavia il prodotto si vende bene.

lessons.title: Compress without hiding an agent
lessons.outcome: I can condense a clause while keeping who did what clear.
lessons.takeaway: Compress an action, but preserve its actor and object.

objectives.label: Use nominalization with a named agent when it is needed for meaning.
objectives.explanation: A shorter noun phrase is useful only if the performer and affected item stay recoverable.

teach.title: Agent retained
teach.body: Da parte del consiglio names the approving actor.

examples.it: L’approvazione del piano da parte del consiglio è attesa.
examples.en: The council’s approval of the plan is awaited.

teach.title: Expand for clarity
teach.body: A finite clause can restore the agent if a nominal phrase becomes opaque.

examples.it: Il consiglio ha approvato il piano.
examples.en: The council approved the plan.

teach.tip: Conciseness must not erase a needed distinction.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: “L’approvazione del piano ___ consiglio” chiarisce chi approva.
questions.translation: “The approval of the plan by the council” identifies who approves.
questions.explanation: Da parte del explicitly identifies the council as approving agent.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: “L’approvazione del piano da parte del consiglio” chiarisce chi approva.

questions.prompt: Condense into one sentence beginning L’approvazione.
questions.context: Il consiglio ha approvato il piano. Questo è avvenuto ieri.
questions.translation: The council approved the plan yesterday.
questions.answer: L’approvazione del piano da parte del consiglio è avvenuta ieri.
questions.explanation: The nominalization retains plan and council and compresses the two clauses.
questions.speak: L’approvazione del piano da parte del consiglio è avvenuta ieri.

questions.prompt: Select the phrase that states what the director decided.
questions.context: La decisione del direttore di chiudere è stata comunicata.
questions.translation: The director’s decision to close was communicated.
questions.answer: la decisione del direttore di chiudere
options: la decisione del direttore di chiudere
questions.explanation: The infinitive di chiudere states the content of the decision.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: La decisione del direttore di chiudere è stata comunicata.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: La firma del contratto da parte del cliente è prevista domani.
questions.translation: The signing of the contract by the customer is scheduled for tomorrow.
questions.answer: La firma del contratto da parte del cliente è prevista domani.
questions.explanation: The formal phrase keeps both the contract and signer explicit.
questions.speak: La firma del contratto da parte del cliente è prevista domani.

lessons.title: Parallel clauses in edited prose
lessons.outcome: I can repair an uneven pair of coordinated complements.
lessons.takeaway: Coordinate like with like: a ridurre ... e a migliorare....

objectives.label: Give coordinated items the same grammatical form when they play the same role.
objectives.explanation: Parallelism makes a comparison or list easier to parse without changing its meaning.

teach.title: Two infinitives
teach.body: The same governing verb can coordinate two infinitives.

examples.it: Il piano mira a ridurre i costi e a migliorare il servizio.
examples.en: The plan aims to reduce costs and improve service.

teach.title: Matching prepositions
teach.body: Repeat a governing preposition when it helps symmetry and clarity.

examples.it: Puntiamo a capire il problema e a risolverlo.
examples.en: We aim to understand the problem and solve it.

teach.tip: A parallel rewrite should keep both actions.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Il piano mira a ridurre i costi e ___ il servizio.
questions.translation: The plan aims to reduce costs and to improve service.
questions.explanation: A migliorare parallels a ridurre after mira.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il piano mira a ridurre i costi e a migliorare il servizio.

questions.prompt: Rewrite with two parallel infinitives.
questions.context: Puntiamo a capire il problema e alla sua soluzione.
questions.translation: We aim to understand the problem and solve it.
questions.answer: Puntiamo a capire il problema e a risolverlo.
accepted: Puntiamo a comprendere il problema e a risolverlo.
questions.explanation: Two a + infinitive complements form a parallel pair.
questions.speak: Puntiamo a capire il problema e a risolverlo.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: L’accordo serve a proteggere i dati e ___ gli utenti.
questions.translation: The agreement serves to protect data and inform users.
questions.explanation: A informare parallels a proteggere under serve.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: L’accordo serve a proteggere i dati e a informare gli utenti.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Vogliamo chiarire i fatti e correggere gli errori.
questions.translation: We want to clarify the facts and correct the errors.
questions.answer: Vogliamo chiarire i fatti e correggere gli errori.
questions.explanation: The two infinitives are parallel complements of vogliamo.
questions.speak: Vogliamo chiarire i fatti e correggere gli errori.

units.title: Interpret and produce
units.description: Apply grammar choices across short authentic-style situations.

lessons.title: Read stance across two sentences
lessons.outcome: I can identify what is asserted and what remains a possibility.
lessons.takeaway: Source marking plus verb mood show how strongly a claim is presented.

objectives.label: Track both source marking and grammatical mood across a short report.
objectives.explanation: A conditional attributed to a source reports a claim; an indicative confirmation asserts verified information.

teach.title: Unverified claim
teach.body: Secondo voci marks a reported source; the conditional maintains distance.

examples.it: Secondo voci, il direttore si sarebbe dimesso.
examples.en: According to rumors, the director has reportedly resigned.

teach.title: Verified update
teach.body: A later confirmation can switch to indicative.

examples.it: L’ufficio ha confermato che si è dimesso.
examples.en: The office confirmed that he resigned.

teach.tip: Do not treat the first sentence as the same evidential status as the second.

questions.prompt: Choose the status licensed by the whole sentence.
questions.context: “Secondo voci, il direttore si sarebbe dimesso.” La frase presenta le dimissioni come ___ .
questions.translation: “According to rumors, the director has reportedly resigned.” How certain is the claim?
questions.explanation: Secondo voci with the conditional marks an unconfirmed report.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Secondo voci, il direttore si sarebbe dimesso.

questions.prompt: Rewrite as a complete sentence with ha confermato che.
questions.context: L’ufficio ha confermato le dimissioni del direttore.
questions.translation: The office has confirmed the director’s resignation.
questions.answer: L’ufficio ha confermato che il direttore si è dimesso.
questions.explanation: The indicative after ha confermato presents an official confirmation.
questions.speak: L’ufficio ha confermato che il direttore si è dimesso.

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: “L’ufficio ha confermato che il direttore si è dimesso.” Qui l’evento è ___ .
questions.translation: “The office confirmed that the director resigned.” How is the event presented?
questions.explanation: Ha confermato marks the content as verified by the office.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: L’ufficio ha confermato che il direttore si è dimesso.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: Secondo fonti non confermate, la seduta sarebbe stata rinviata.
questions.translation: According to unconfirmed sources, the sitting was reportedly postponed.
questions.answer: Secondo fonti non confermate, la seduta sarebbe stata rinviata.
questions.explanation: The source phrase and conditional jointly signal limited certainty.
questions.speak: Secondo fonti non confermate, la seduta sarebbe stata rinviata.

lessons.title: Choose a precise final wording
lessons.outcome: I can produce a concise, logically precise sentence for a specified audience.
lessons.takeaway: State the exact condition or request in a short, audience-appropriate sentence.

objectives.label: Combine condition, consequence and register in a single short rewrite.
objectives.explanation: Check the intended relation and recipient before choosing the grammatical form.

teach.title: Condition and consequence
teach.body: A formal notice can state a condition clearly.

examples.it: In caso di pioggia, la visita sarà rinviata.
examples.en: In case of rain, the visit will be postponed.

teach.title: Courteous follow-up
teach.body: A formal request can use a conditional question.

examples.it: Potrebbe confermarmi il nuovo orario?
examples.en: Could you confirm the new time for me?

teach.tip: Precision includes both logic and audience.

questions.prompt: Choose the notice that preserves the stated condition.
questions.context: Avviso formale: la visita si rinvia solo se piove. “___”
questions.translation: Formal notice: the visit is postponed only if it rains.
questions.answer: In caso di pioggia, la visita sarà rinviata.
options: In caso di pioggia, la visita sarà rinviata.
La visita sarà rinviata anche senza pioggia.
Sebbene piova, la visita è confermata.
questions.explanation: In caso di pioggia states the intended condition without changing it.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: In caso di pioggia, la visita sarà rinviata.

questions.prompt: Rewrite with Potrebbe.
questions.context: Conferma il nuovo orario.
questions.translation: Confirm the new time; write a courteous request to an office.
accepted: Mi potrebbe confermare il nuovo orario?
questions.explanation: The conditional question suits the formal recipient and keeps the request.
questions.speak: Potrebbe confermarmi il nuovo orario?

questions.prompt: Choose the form that fits the stated meaning.
questions.context: Il museo è chiuso per lavori; ___ la visita è stata rinviata.
questions.translation: The museum is closed for works; therefore the visit was postponed.
questions.explanation: Pertanto states the consequence of the closure.
questions.hint: Use the clause meaning and time cue.
questions.speak: Il museo è chiuso per lavori; pertanto la visita è stata rinviata.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to express this meaning.
questions.context: In caso di ritardo, potrebbe avvisare la segreteria?
questions.translation: In case of delay, could you inform the office?
questions.answer: In caso di ritardo, potrebbe avvisare la segreteria?
questions.explanation: The condition is explicit and the conditional request is courteous.
questions.speak: In caso di ritardo, potrebbe avvisare la segreteria?
